modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On March 14, 1995: Norman Thagard becomes the first American astronaut to ride to space on board a Russian launch vehicle.
On March 14, 1942: Anne Miller becomes the first American patient to be treated with penicillin, under the care of Orvan Hess and John Bumstead.
On March 14, 1931: Alam Ara, India's first talking film, is released.
On March 14, 1903: Pelican Island National Wildlife Refuge, the first national wildlife refuge in the US, is established by President Theodore Roosevelt.
March 14 is observed as Nanakshahi New Year, first day of the month of Chet (Sikhism).
